## s12-v06 — argument map

May my mind (tvadvilokanasamutkacetaso), risen to see You, gain this yoga-fruit (yogasiddhir iyatī) always (sadāstu me). To enter Your nectar-house (yad viśeyam abhisandhimātratas tvatsudhāsadanam) by mere resolve (abhisandhimātratas), for Your worship (arcanāya te). Entering by resolve: mere resolve suffices for the nectar-house.

### Open
- Whether 'abhisandhimātratas' means 'by mere resolve' or 'by resolve alone' is unresolved.
- Whether 'yogasiddhir iyatī' means 'this yoga-fruit' or 'this much yoga-siddhi' is unresolved.
